findings.location: Lighthouse.Frontend/src/components/Common/FeatureListDataGrid/FeatureListDataGrid.search.test.tsx offers an empty box test, toolbar placement assertion
findings.obligation: P1 expectation: box sits in the toolbar row before the copy, export and layout icons (acceptance.md S1 P1 row)
findings.observation: Quote: compareDocumentPosition(screen.getByTestId("copy-button")) only. Export and layout icons are not asserted. A box inserted between copy and export passes.
findings.remediation: Compare the box against the last toolbar icon (layout) or against each icon, so the whole before-the-icons expectation is pinned.

findings.obligation: Oracle must observe an exact semantic checkpoint; an import failure must not masquerade as a semantic failure (nw-at-completeness-check, Environment closure)
findings.observation: Quote: loaded = await import(/* @vite-ignore */ MATCHER_FILE).catch(() => ({})); The catch turns any load error into a missing-function message: quickSearchValues is missing. A syntax or import error in quickSearch.ts is then reported as a missing export.
findings.remediation: The module now exists; import quickSearchValues and shownTextQuickFilter statically and drop the catch, the variable path and the header comment about pre-implementation loading.

findings.obligation: test-writing checklist item 10: names are plain words; no internal ids in test names
findings.observation: Quote: "... in any letter case (law L1)", "(law L2)", "(law L3)" in it() and it.each titles. Feature-doc obligation ids leak into test output.
findings.remediation: Remove the parenthetical law ids from the titles; keep the plain sentence.

findings.obligation: Craftsmanship rule 10: a value shared by two units gets one named constant; precedent ReportNotes.tsx:71 uses UsageDataEventName.ReportNoteAdded
findings.observation: Quote: searchReported.current = reportUsage({ name: "FeatureListSearched" }); the name is spelled as a literal, though UsageDataService.ts:56 now defines the constant.

findings.obligation: Craftsmanship rule 2: one owner per fact; blank typed text decided twice
findings.observation: Quote: quickSearchValues returns trimmed === "" ? [] : [trimmed]; shownTextQuickFilter has if (needle === "") return null; both trim the typed text. The null branch is not reached from the grid, since blank values never reach it.
findings.remediation: Keep the blank rule in quickSearchValues only; drop the second trim and blank branch from shownTextQuickFilter or document it as a precondition.
